Thanks for the details, Sam — and nice to e-meet you. Quick intake notes from Legal: 

- Confirmed legal entity and jurisdiction — we will populate the MSA header with Helio Data Solutions, Inc. (DE).
- Billing: procurement@heliocorp.com + Lydia Park noted. Please confirm whether Helio requires invoice-level PO numbers on each invoice or a single PO covering the term. That affects billing workflow.
- Data residency: we can propose an Exhibit for EU-sourced data; need a short description of the expected dataset types and processing locations (edge inference vs. data storage).
- SLA credits: Redwood's standard SLA includes latency and availability tiers; if Helio needs lower latency SLOs we will need to map to a dedicated capacity commitment (Dedicated) or hybrid routing.

Proposed next steps and timing: 
1) Hannah/AE to confirm PO expectations (today).
2) Legal to prepare a first-pass redline of our MSA + Order Form (target 72 business hours after PO confirmation).
3) Joint call with Helio procurement/legal to review redlines (30 min) — propose Wed 21 Sep 2026 11:00 AM PT or Thu 22 Sep 2026 9:00 AM PT.

Small clarifying Qs for Sam/Marta: 
- Which EU countries are in scope for dataset residency? (short list is fine)
- Do you expect any custom IP exhibits (customer model ownership, outputs) or is standard Redwood IP language acceptable?

If you prefer a direct DocuSign NDA/Doc exchange, I can route our intake packet to your procurement contact.

Thanks — Marissa
